description: Export Ledger And Invoice Download File. Part of the Account APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

type.description: Voucher or entity type discriminator for the list. Default: view-detailed.

format.description: Response or export format. Default: xlsx.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: asc.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour.

accountCurrency.description: Account currency query parameter. Default: true.
